balls.text: fullish, can't connect as well as he would have liked, thick inside edge through square leg for a couple of runs
full toss and Harbhajan finds the gap, smacks it away over square leg for four more
bowled on a length outside off and Harbhajan's been waiting for that one, gives it a big swing, connects well and clears the long-on boundary
plays that one away for a single
tries to swing that over midwicket, gets a thick inside edge for a couple of runs
third man is up and Rohit plays that smartly, the slower one there, waited for it and beat that gap between point and short third
low full toss outside off, comes down the track and cracks it towards deep cover for a single
yorker length on the off, can only dig it out back to the bowler
slower one, the legcutter, this has been called a wide, tried to swing that over long-on
misses, full and wide and he tried to slice that over point, missed
dropped, hard chance for Raina, pitched up and Rohit absolutely crashed that through point, Raina dived over and to his right, couldn't hold on
ooh, Rohit will feel he missed out there, tried to launch that through the line over long-off, missed
he'll take it, full outside off, tries to drive it through off, gets a thick edge past Dhoni to the third-man boundary
nicely struck, pitched up outside off, plenty of width there and he smacks that hard past extra cover, lots of width there for him to free his arms
bowled full outside off, reaches for it to squeeze it towards third man, misses
well fielded at long-on by Bravo, on a length on middle and that was struck hard past the bowler, Bravo ran to his left and kept them to a single
short and that's pulled away into the deep on the leg side for a single
erring in length there, that landed right in the slot on the off and it was thrashed miles over the long-on boundary
bowled it full on the off, that's been defended towards point
slower one on the off, swings it towards deep square leg for a single, didn't connect it well enough
a bit of relief for Mumbai, Dhoni was standing up, Bravo pushed one full and wide and Rohit went hard at that, smacking it over extra cover
dropped wide of the keeper for a quick single
on a length, driven towards extra cover and races through for a single
back of  a length, cut towards third man who is standing a little square, just the single
short and wide, cuts that one towards third man for a single
fullish on middle plays it wide of the bowler but cannot get it past midwicket
the carrom ball, it goes past the outside edge after landing outside off
full on middle, drives it towards long-on for a single
shortish outside off, cut through point into the deep for a single
tossed up and he's hit his first ball for six, in the slot on the off and he's drilled that over the long-on boundary
bowled'im! Rayudu misses a short ball, the shot was on, turned in from outside off and he tried to smack that over square leg, just missed it and the ball knocked into the off stump
hard to dispatch, slower one bowled short outside off, comes down the track and cracks it straight to extra cover, just the single
short, comes down the track and slaps it towards extra cover, just the single
sneaks in a quick single by playing that towards mid-off
goodish length, chops that one behind point for a single
goes for the pull, slower one, shortish outside off, tried to go over square leg, missed
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and guides him to point
quicker through the air, short on the off, gets back and defends it into the leg side
tossed up outside off, drives it through to long-off for a single
full on middle, comes down the track and drives it straight to midwicket
played in the direction of short third man for a single
this one goes on straight, tries to open the face, misses
turns in from outside off, drops it in front of point after waiting for it to turn in
slower one bowled outside off, runs that to third man to keep strike
opens the face to guide it towards third man for a single
superbly done, short outside off and Rayudu guides that for six, just helping it over the keeper's head, landed just on the ropes, or may have landed just in front, given a four
slower one bowled full outside off, drives that through extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
superb yorker first up, on middle and he manages to dig that out into the leg side
slower one bowled short outside off, cut towards third man for a single
angling in towards middle, drives that one back to the bowler
he's got a bit carried away there, floating it on middle and he goes for another slog-sweep, can't get the elevation and struck it straight to deep midwicket, Raina took it easily
enterprising batting this, flat on the off and he helps it on its way past point with a reverse-sweep, lovely shot
the slog-sweep this time, tossed up on the off, reaches forward and smacks that hard over deep midwicket
plays it really fine this time, takes it from off and middle  and sweeps it over short fine leg for a boundary
appeal for lbw, Karthik tries to sweep it square, shortish on leg, struck on the thigh, that may have missed leg
full outside off, drives it over the bowler and towards mid-off for a single
bowled it full on the off, opens the face and plays it to point for a single
played that one away behind square on the leg side for a single

short of a length, cut away through point into the deep for a couple of runs, Rohit survives a run-out chance, Morris returns a throw from the deep to the non-striker's end and Laughlin misses while trying to throw down the stumps
bowled it full, he rocks on the front foot and plays it into the leg side
flighted outside off, defended to cover
driven to long-off for one
tries the reverse sweep, is hit on the pad by a full ball. Has just got outside the line, though
defended off the front foot
full, on off, driven to long-off
Jadeja gets another. Pollard has crumbled under the pressure. Gets a length ball, middle and leg, and he wants to hit it for a six. However, he fails to time it, and holes out to long-on
fullish on the off, gets forward and drives that towards extra cover, time-out time
angling in towards middle, pushed through midwicket into the deep for a single
wristy from Karthik, gets across and flicks it towards fine leg for a single
full toss on middle, he gets across and pushes it back down the pitch but Morris fields it well
dropped that short and he saw it through to the keeper, one for the over
slightly short outside off, chopped towards point from the crease

dropped, tough to call it dropped, pitched up and he drove it hard back towards the bowler, Bravo was on his follow through but couldn't hold on, the ball ricocheted off the hands and just missed the stumps at the non-striker's end but Karthik was in
angling in full on middle, drives it towards mid-on off the front foot
Bravo snares Smith, short outside off and he tries to flat-bat that over the bowler's head, gets a top-edge, Bravo says "it's mine", judges it well and does a jig, Raina is stunned at the act
angling in towards middle, walks across and flicks it through square leg for a single
drops it into the off side, wants the single but Smith wisely sends him back
bowled it on a good length on the off, knocked it into the off side towards cover
tossed up on the off, drives it towards long-off for a single

Tendulkar's been given out lbw, bowled it quicker through the air on middle and leg, appeared to pitch in line, Tendulkar tried to work it into the leg side, seemed to be struck in line of leg stump, Tendulkar missed it and it seemed quite adjacent, Tendulkar is gone
shortish on middle and leg, turns it towards short fine for a single
rocks forward and plays it back to the bowler
in the slot and Smith doesn't waste it, smashes it hard over the long-on boundary, clears the ropes by a fair distance
on middle and off, turned through square leg into the deep for a single
shortish on the off, crunched towards extra cover from the crease
on a good length, drops it towards point and thinks of a single but it's not there
on the off stump, whips it wide of square leg for a single, thinks of a second but it's not there
superbly done, Tendulkar gets across to Mohit and scoops it over short fine, in fact he cleared the fine-leg boundary comfortably, used the pace wonderfully there
Tendulkar attacks, on a good length and he smashes that past the bowler, over the umpire, on the up, gets enough on it to send it for four
on a good length, gets forward and turns it towards midwicket
angling in towards middle and Smith gets rid of that one, flicking it hard between mid-on and midwicket
short and wide, slashes that, tries to crash that through point, misses
slower one bowled on a length on the off, Smith stays in his crease and gets an inside edge onto the pads
full on the off, drives it past the bowler towards mid-off, Bravo dives to his right and stops that
this one is a wide, down the leg side this time, comfortably, and the umpire calls it
on a good length outside off and he pushes that loosely towards cover
Tendulkar swivels and tries to dispatch that behind square, went a little down the leg side, may have just gone over the stumps there, Tendulkar moved well across there
tries to push that through extra cover off the front foot, gets an inside edge onto the pads
angling in towards off and middle, gets back and pushes it down the pitch
That wasn't Tendulkar but it did remind you of him, in the slot on middle and Dwayne Smith launches that over the bowler's head, lovely straight hit
angling in towards off and middle, pushes it towards the bowler
tries to punch it past extra cover, that kept a little low, gets an inside edge onto the pads
short of a good length on middle, rocks on the back foot and defends it in front of the bowler
on a good length outside off, Tendulkar follows it and punches it towards extra cover
dropped that short on the off, jabs it wide of mid-on for a couple of runs, Vijay at mid-on slides and tries to flip the ball to Hussey, misses, it ends up going over his head, an extra run to Mumbai
shortish on the off, runs that one down to third man for a single
slides that one down the leg side, the second one to Tendulkar today
goodish length on middle, defended wide of midwicket for a single
sliding on the pads, tries to force it through the leg side, struck high on the pads
angling in towards off and middle and that's been played into the leg side
short of a length outside off, mistimes a cut towards point, can't get it past that fielder
swinging in, fullish on middle, clips it wide of square leg but cannot pierce the field, no run on offer there
big stride out, nipped back in from outside off, struck him in line, clips the pads and lobs up, hit the top of the pads and would have gone over
short of a good length on the off, rocks on the back foot and punches it towards cover
bowled that on a length on the off, drives it solidly towards mid-off
in the channel outside off stump this time and Tendulkar leaves that alone to the keeper
begins with a wide down the leg side
fired it on middle and leg, that's been clipped through square leg into the deep for a couple of runs
tossed up on the of, drives it past Jadeja who misfields and allows Sachin to take the single
sliding on the pads, pushed in front of square leg for a single
flat on middle, pushed back towards the bowler
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it into the leg side
angling in towards middle, driven past the bowler towards mid-on
Mumbai have thrashed Chennai, Jadeja was trying to clear deep square leg there, found Rayudu there who took an easy catch, massive win for the hosts
tossed up on middle, drives it towards long-on for a single
full outside off, played down towards third man for a single
full on the off and that's been defended towards extra cover
fullish outside off, plays it towards point from the crease
trying for the slower yorker, picks it at the last moment and plays it away towards cover
slower one bowled on a length outside off, guides it through point into the deep for a single
yorker on middle, digs it out with an inside edge on the pads, they steal a single
short and wide and Jadeja cuts it hard over point for a boundary
another wide down the leg side from Johnson
low full toss outside off, drives it towards deep cover for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, runs that down to third man for a single
Dropped by Pollard, tough one, short and Jadeja pulls it, Pollard runs a mile to his left from long-on, dives, catches and spills it when he hits the ground, popped out
oh dear, five wides now, slower one bowled down the leg side and Karthik failed to get his body behind that one
Jadeja gets four, comes down the track and tries to pull that over midwicket, gets an edge over the keeper's head for a boundary
drops it short on middle, goes for the pull and it lands safe in the deep
low full toss outside off, Laughlin gets some bat to it, plays it towards point
back of a length on middle, defends it into the off side for a single
Nine down, full and wide and that's been sliced to deep point, taken a couple of yards in front of the boundary, Mohit Sharma is gone
bowled that one short on middle, manages to duck under that one
another attempt at a yorker, this time it's outside off, misses
Morris is gone, bowled'im! Bowled at 134.4kmph, yorker length on the off, Morris failed to get his bat down in time, off stump has been knocked back
flat on middle, comes down the track and pushes it towards midwicket, Rayudu sends a wild throw to the keeper, well backed-up at short third
full on middle, that's been swept to deep backward square leg for a single
lands flat on the off, gets forward and defends it towards extra cover
slips that one down the leg side, called a wide
falls just short of extra cover, leading edge as it turns away and he closes the face, falls just short of Rayudu

Dhoni has holed out, is this the end? Ojha flights it, lands in the slot for Dhoni and he can't clear long-off, was hoping to get it wide of that fielder, struck it straight into the hands of Pollard at long-off who takes it comfortably
angling in towards middle, drops that into the off side
angling in towards middle, defends it on the pitch
shortish on middle, worked towards midwicket, Suyal does a good job this time preventing the single
fullish on the off, gets forward and pushes that towards extra cover
missed run-out, the bowler wasn't near the stumps as he should have been, pushed wide of midwicket, Dhoni was running the second towards the non-striker's end, a throw from the deep, misses
shortish on the off, cut towards Tendulkar at point, big cheers
floating it on the off, gets across and turns it towards square leg for two runs, Suyal runs to his left but has been put under pressure by the pair there
shortish on middle, gets back and knocks it in front of midwicket, the fielder in the deep takes a while to run in, they snatch two in the meantime
on a good length on the off, pushes it towards cover
Dhoni finds the gap, tossed up on the off and he swings it wide of long-on for a one bounce four
tossed up on the off, drives it wide of long-on for a single
floating it on middle, worked through square leg for a single
Hussey goes, Ojha has struck, tossed up on the off and Hussey slog-swept it but straight to deep midwicket, struck it well and flat but found the fielder, easy catch for Smith
fired it quick on the off, Dhoni gets on the back foot and defends it into the leg side
width and that's been cracked towards deep point for a single
angling in towards leg stump, gets forward and stabs it in front of the bowler in the off side
tossed up on middle, nudges that in the direction of square leg for one more
plays it down in front of point and cover for a single
round the wicket, angling towards middle, tries to close the face, was the doosra, gets a leading edge and it falls safe in front of point
bowled it short on middle, Dhoni pulls that towards deep square leg for a single
pulled this time, plays it in front of deep square leg, Smith runs to his right and cuts it off
short again and Hussey was taken a little by surprise there, took his eyes off it as he went for the pull, somehow made contact with the bat
bowled it short and Hussey went for the pull, got an inside edge onto the body there, no run again
short of a good length, tries to guide that behind point, gets an under-edge towards the keeper
bowled on a good length on the off, pushes that straight towards extra cover
fired it quick from round the wicket outside off, Dhoni tried to cut that past point, missed
Dhoni gets forward and tries to knock that down fine, misses, is hit on the pads
What was Ashwin doing there? Tossed up on middle, Ashwin moved well wide of leg stump and tries to stab that into the off side, it turned in, he missed, and it knocked leg stump
gets on the back foot and turns that past midwicket for a single
shortish outside off, Ashwin slaps that one wide of extra cover for a single
Ashwin comes down the track to Harbhajan and drives it towards midwicket
excellent fielding, Hussey pulled that well in front of deep square leg, Smith ran a fair distance to his right, stretched and dragged that back in to keep them to just two
goodish length on the off, defends it towards extra cover from the crease
banged in short and he doesn't have to duck, it's that high, called a wide
moved across a fair amount there did Ashwin, struck him a little high on the pads as he tries to work it square, they get a leg-bye
short again and that's been pulled to deep square leg for a single
connects superbly, bowled it short, picked the length early, rocked back and pulled it clean over square leg, landed in the second tier
dropped that one short on middle, jabs that towards midwicket from the crease
tossed up on the off, drives it through extra cover into the deep for just the single
tossed up on leg stump, gets off the mark with a nudge past midwicket
fired it quick on middle, gets on the back foot and works it towards midwicket
bowled it flat again and that's been pushed back to the bowler
round the wicket to Ashwin as well, bowled flat on the off, comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler
round the wicket, angling in towards off and middle, gets an inside edge for a single
Suyal strikes now, short of a good length and Bravo punches that hard but straight to extra cover, Rayudu's the man there and he gives Bravo a send-off
Bravo's been hit on the ribs, back of a length, tries to pull it square and misses, struck him hard and he's in some pain
pitched up and Bravo cashes in, launching that one over the covers for a one bounce four
nicely timed, shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and flicks it through square, Rohit gives chase and tries to drag it back in but it's too quick for him
shortish on the off, punched towards point, Pollard moves to his left and stops it
pitched up and that's been thrashed but straight to Dwayne Smith at extra cover, got his body behind that one somehow
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and works it through square leg for a single

that's out, Badrinath has a stunned look on his face but that was pad first, landed on the off, may have nipped back, Badrinath rocked forward to drive that through the covers, missed, it struck him in line and it would have gone on to hit off and middle, that looked out and Dharmasena thought so too
swinging in and smacks him on the pads as he tries to flick it square, yorker length, landed just outside leg stump
beaten, short of a good length and it moved away, Badri poked at that one and missed

Has that carried to Pollard?, angling in towards middle, Raina tried to close the face on that one, tried to flick it square, got a leading edge and Pollard moved to his left, that was dying on him but he dived forward and got his hands just under that one, yes, replays show the catch was clean,  on the fourth attempt, he makes sure he makes no mistake.
bowled'im, Johnson has struck, he'll be relieved, full outside off and Vijay goes for a drive, tried to drive it away from his body there, got an inside edge onto the stumps
bowled it full outside off, driven into the ground and towards extra cover
on a good length on the off, gets on the front foot and defends it into the off side
gets an inside edge onto the pads as he tries to drop that into the off side, they pick a quick single
straying on the pads, tries to play it down fine, struck high on the pads and they sneak a leg-bye
shaped in, nicely bowled, Vijay gets across and pushes it towards midwicket
short of a length outside off, Ponting dives to his right to stop that cut shot and there's big cheers around the ground

This can't be happening, Pollard has dropped three in a row, has this ever happened in cricket? Three identical drops in three balls, short and wide and Hussey cuts it straight to Pollard, the unlikeliest man to drop such catches, and he's put all three of them down

Pollard drops it again, short and wide and this one's even more reachable, cut straight to him, and not very firmly, bends down to catch it in front of his stomach, easy chance this and he's spilt it once again
dropped, Pollard spills one, a tough, sharp chance at point, that should have been taken, short and wide and it's cut over him, he ends up palming it over his head to the boundary
found the gap, full outside off, opened the face and squeezed it between cover and point for a couple of runs
swinging away there, and moved after pitching too, Hussey saw that through to the keeper
full on middle, Hussey defends that one towards mid-on
